title: A learner corrects the intended topic

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?
I fall asleep okay because I'm exhausted, but I'm wide awake at three or four every morning. That's the worst part of the day. Just me and the ceiling.

currentLearnerUtterance: No, I meant your energy during the day, not how you sleep.

should: Accept the correction and answer about low daytime energy.
Preserve the distinction between the requested topic and the excluded one.
mustNot: Do not keep answering the sleep question after the correction.
Do not introduce a new energy symptom or activity limitation.
